_source: Compro Rev 3 hal. 6 (Corporate Journey Affirmate Group).

text.en: ABN and APN established. Acted as exclusive advisor for the Menteng Eksekutif (Agung Podomoro) transaction.
text.id: ABN dan APN berdiri. Menjadi penasihat eksklusif transaksi Menteng Eksekutif (Agung Podomoro).

text.en: Supported PT Tatamulia third-party share allotment transaction. Established PT Ritz Affirmate Internasional (JV).
text.id: Mendukung transaksi penjatahan saham pihak ketiga PT Tatamulia. Mendirikan PT Ritz Affirmate Internasional (JV).

text.en: Provided strategic advisory on investment concept and development structure for the Toda Corp × Ciputra high-rise project (~IDR 1.5T).
text.id: Memberikan advisory strategis atas konsep investasi dan struktur pengembangan proyek hunian vertikal Toda Corp × Ciputra (~Rp1,5 T).

text.en: ATN established. Launched administrative platform business, providing work permit, licensing and corporate support services.
text.id: ATN berdiri. Meluncurkan bisnis platform administrasi: layanan izin kerja, perizinan, dan dukungan korporat.

text.en: Partnership with The 77 Bank. Began hosting expatriate officer.
text.id: Kemitraan dengan The 77 Bank. Mulai menjadi host bagi pejabat ekspatriat bank tersebut.

text.en: Acted as lead advisor for the NTT East × SURGE strategic investment (~IDR 4T).
text.id: Menjadi penasihat utama investasi strategis NTT East × SURGE (~Rp4 T).

text.en: Acquired a 5.6% equity stake in PT BOT Finance (member of MUFG). BARTIGA / JTC launched.
text.id: Mengakuisisi 5,6% saham PT BOT Finance (anggota MUFG). BARTIGA / JTC diluncurkan.
